pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/41705

**Validation**

```csharp
app.MapGet("/", () => "Look ma! No params.")
    .AddFilter((c, n) => n(c));
```

```ps
> 1..1000 | % { curl http://localhost:5000 }
```
**Before Change**
|Type|Allocations|
|-|-|
| + System.Object\[\]|1,698|
|\| - System.Object\[0\]|1,003|

**After Change**
|Type|Allocations|
|-|-|
| + System.Object\[\]|702|
|\| - System.Object\[0\]|2|

issue_context.title: Filters that don't have any parameters shouldn't allocate an empty array

review_comments: Shouldn't MakeGenericMethod be hoisted to the stored MethodInfo so we use the same one for every filter factory?
Can cache this one for object too since we're not using the open generic to close over other arrays yes.
